content:
“The Invader is a strange piece of alien technology with an unknown purpose. It makes a great melee weapon though!”— Atomic Shop description 
**The Invader** is a melee weapon in *Fallout 76*.

## Gameplay[edit]

An alien probe which makes for an excellent melee weapon. It is a reskinned Combat Knife. It cannot drop as a legendary item.

## Location[edit]

The skin can be purchased in the Atomic Shop for 400 Atoms or as part of the Invasion from the Stars bundle for 1500 Atoms.

Although advertised as a skin, The Invader is a craftable weapon.
